verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a payroll/HR SaaS that holds sensitive employee data, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documentation of user-configurable retention periods, deletion requests or purge controls. The 'up to three years of W-2s/1099s' item describes how far back employees can view records, not a retention or deletion control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
